summary: Candidate 'Configure Maven Classloading and Module Dependencies' is a specialized workflow within the broader 'Maven Dependency Resolution' skill. Both address dependency management in Maven, but the candidate focuses on multi-module project structure and classloading as a subset of general dependency resolution. The peer candidates (Repository Sources, Install Third-Party JAR) are orthogonal concerns. Merging into the existing Maven Dependency Resolution skill consolidates related workflows and avoids fragmentation of the same capability.
